title: radiation.agent_contract/1 — Agent Contracts catalog
description: Typed record for provider agent contracts bounded by receipts; D4 law no simulated Commander authority becomes machine-checked. P-19 G4: providers get typed contracts bounded by receipts. MEM-shrine-log is a deliberate outer-corpus pointer (docs/shrine/LOG.md); all other catalog paths MUST live under Brain/ or agents/.

id.description: unique id AGT-<slug>, slug is provider lower-kebab, unique

provider.description: provider directory name, e.g., Arena_AI, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok

capabilities.description: capabilities seeded only from facts already on file in profile, receipt tiers honest

tier.description: receipt tier: primary=Official, secondary=Secondary, asserted=User-reported or asserted, benchmark=Benchmark

receipt_ref.description: receipt ref e.g., O15, O10, SOURCES.md lane, or null if asserted gap

boundary_note.description: model≠host separation note, e.g., host is session-contingent, model identity unknowable, tool surface session-specific

no_simulated_commander_authority.description: D4 law: no simulated Commander authority — must be exactly true, false impossible

status.description: active=profile exists and capabilities seeded, draft=needs note, deprecated=needs superseded_by

note.description: optional note, required if status draft

superseded_by.description: required if status deprecated, id of contract that supersedes
